verdict.rationale: Portkey documents a Logs section that lists every request processed through the gateway, with shareable per-log URLs and filtering. Separate pages mention tracking 40+ metrics, including cost and latency, and granular cost tracking. However, the evidence never says each logged request shows its response body, latency, token count, and cost. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-log response payloads, per-request latency, token-count and cost fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can inspect logged requests and responses with latency, token counts, and cost attached

citations.quote: The Logs section presents a chronological list of all the requests processed through Portkey.
Each log on Portkey has a unique URL.
Track 40+ crucial metrics in real time. Optimize costs, monitor quality, and reduce latency for peak performance.
